title: Creator Sphere
tagline: The 360 Degree way to engage and retain your audience. We achieve this using SBTs and erc20 tokens.
description:
Content creators need a way to engage with their superfans. However, they need to operate within the existing social apps (YouTube, Instagram, Discord, Twitter) because that is where their audience is and where they can achieve distribution. 

'Creator Sphere' is an application that allows them to hyper-personalize their relationship with these superfans by minting SBTs and earning tokens on various social apps. 

These tokens are then used for DAO Voting as well as get them special privileges on Discord and Telegram.
how_its_made:
All the contracts are deployed on AirDAO. There are 3 in total. The first is the SBT contract, the second is the erc20 token contract and a third one that allows creators to create new tasks (carrying rewards), delete existing tasks, and it checks and verifies whether the task was completed before dispensing the tokens on-chain. 

We have used World ID to verify proof-of-humanity and have used MACI for DAO voting.
